A refusal-removed derivative sits directly against that clause. Not listed until the operator clears it.
openuncensored/inkling-2-mini-uncensored.served_artifact_note: The served artifact is our own oQ4e quant of this source with the served row's recipe; it does not exist yet, so it has no repo, revision, hash or size. The source snapshot ships edit.pt (a 20,934-byte PyTorch pickle); the quant build reads only the safetensors, config and tokenizer files and never unpickles it.
